parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly leaves Part B open. Its pigeonhole argument produces a small signed sum but acknowledges that the sum may not be realizable by Xiang’s allowed cuts, and the proposed fallback is only empirical and unproved. No other passage supplies a universal construction for every Liu division. Establishing L3.2 therefore requires a substantive lemma connecting suitable subset sums to an admissible cancellation/overlay strategy using at most n cuts.
